claim_label: approximate reproduction; frozen crop-group refinement diagnostic

evaluation.normalization: Unicode casefold; remove Unicode punctuation and symbols; preserve accents digits whitespace

scientific_choices.choice: Paper section 3.3 localizes padded components and section 3.5 uses PARSeq-S; neither specifies cross-threshold groups or these refinements.
Reuse frozen original crops, PARSeq readings, whole and tiled probabilities, and complete-link groups.
A coordinate-wise inner-quartile envelope of core boxes replaces the single medoid as the mask-support target; no OCR text or ground truth chooses this reference.

A robust-reference crop switch is accepted only when its unchanged PARSeq balanced character confidence is at least that of the baseline crop. Colliding crop assignments revert to baseline; no learned or dataset-specific gate is used.
Near-identical outputs with bbox IoU >= 0.9 and equal readings or one-character variants of length at least 4 form a conservative second-stage word group.
Independent-dataset transfer, calibration, remaining false positives, and official polygon spotting metrics require separate evaluation.
